content: In addition to this method, we also perform singular value decomposition (SVD) on the cooccurrence matrices, where we compute the matrix $M^{PPMI} = U\Sigma V^{T}$. Positive pointwise mutual information (PPMI) scores between words are calculated and the truncated singular value decomposition is computed. We take into account the U matrix only for each word. We have chosen the singular value number as 200. That is, each word in the corpus is represented by a 200-dimensional vector as follows.
